name: Home, Referrals tab, Android frame
alt: The old Mara app home on Android, Referrals tab: total balance ₦1,500, a yellow Verification Not Complete card, the referral code field with Copy and share, Your referrals (0), and the floating bottom bar; on the one 360x800 Android frame with the shared status bar and gesture pill
note: home-old-01 scaled to 360x800 (its 1080x2400 pixels are exactly 3x that, so nothing is cropped or letterboxed), then the one Android chrome composited over it: a white 48px band with 9:41 and the signal, wifi and battery marks covers the device's own status bar, a white 42px band with the 108x4 pill covers its 3-button bar. Nothing between them is touched. export.png is the composite as PNG, image.webp the same pixels lossless.
